item.title: Wolves v Blackburn: Championship opener – live
item.summary: ⚽ Updates from Molineux; kick-off 8pm BST ⚽ Weekend fixtures | Follow us on Instagram | Mail Dominic The 2025-26 EFL season is five minutes from getting started. We are standing on football’s equivalent of the start line at the London Marathon … a testing 46 games await, many twists and turns to come. Mowbray tells Sky Sports that Blackburn are “going to have to punch above their weight” this season and that his team are looking to make the game “tight” and create a difficult evening for Wolves, who he notes haven’t won many games of football in the past year, albeit in a different division.
